def test_user_address_and_card_management():
    username = f"user_{generate_random_string()}"
    user_data = {
        "username": username,
        "password": "password123",
        "email": f"{username}@example.com",
        "firstName": "Test",
        "lastName": "User"
    }
    requests.post(get_url("user", "/register"), json=user_data, timeout=10)

    # Add address
    address_data = {
        "city": "London",
        "country": "UK",
        "number": "10",
        "postcode": "SW1A 1AA",
        "street": "Downing Street",
        "userID": username
    }
    resp = requests.post(get_url("user", "/addresses"), json=address_data, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    address_id = resp.json().get("id")
    assert address_id is not None

    # Verify address exists in customer's addresses
    resp = requests.get(get_url("user", f"/customers/{username}/addresses"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    addresses = resp.json().get("_embedded", {}).get("address", [])
    assert any(addr.get("id") == address_id for addr in addresses), "Address not found in customer addresses"

    # Add card
    card_data = {
        "longNum": "1234567890123456",
        "expires": "12/25",
        "ccv": "123",
        "userID": username
    }
    resp = requests.post(get_url("user", "/cards"), json=card_data, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    card_id = resp.json().get("id")
    assert card_id is not None

    # Verify card exists in customer's cards
    resp = requests.get(get_url("user", f"/customers/{username}/cards"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    cards = resp.json().get("_embedded", {}).get("card", [])
    assert any(card.get("id") == card_id for card in cards), "Card not found in customer cards"

    # Delete address
    resp = requests.delete(get_url("user", f"/addresses/{address_id}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    # Verify address deleted
    resp = requests.get(get_url("user", f"/customers/{username}/addresses"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    addresses = resp.json().get("_embedded", {}).get("address", [])
    assert not any(addr.get("id") == address_id for addr in addresses), "Address was not deleted"

    # Delete customer
    resp = requests.delete(get_url("user", f"/customers/{username}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    assert resp.json().get("status") is True

    # Verify customer deleted by trying to login
    resp = requests.get(get_url("user", "/login"), auth=(username, "password123"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 401, f"Expected 401, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    # Delete customer again -> status false
    resp = requests.delete(get_url("user", f"/customers/{username}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    assert resp.json().get("status") is False

def test_catalogue_browsing():
    # Get catalogue
    resp = requests.get(get_url("catalogue", "/catalogue"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    socks = resp.json()
    assert isinstance(socks, list)

    if socks:
        sock_id = socks[0].get("id")
        # Get specific sock
        resp = requests.get(get_url("catalogue", f"/catalogue/{sock_id}"), timeout=10)
        assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
        assert resp.json().get("id") == sock_id

    # Negative: Invalid sock ID
    resp = requests.get(get_url("catalogue", "/catalogue/invalid-sock-id-12345"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 404, f"Expected 404, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

def test_cart_management():
    customer_id = f"cust_{generate_random_string()}"

    # Fetch item from catalogue
    cat_resp = requests.get(get_url("catalogue", "/catalogue"), timeout=10)
    assert cat_resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {cat_resp.status_code}: {cat_resp.text}"
    socks = cat_resp.json()
    assert len(socks) > 0, "Catalogue is empty"
    item_id = socks[0].get("id")
    unit_price = socks[0].get("price")

    # Add item to cart
    item_data = {
        "itemId": item_id,
        "quantity": 2,
        "unitPrice": unit_price
    }
    resp = requests.post(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{customer_id}/items"), json=item_data, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 201, f"Expected 201, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    # Verify item in cart
    resp = requests.get(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{customer_id}/items"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    items = resp.json()
    assert len(items) >= 1
    assert any(item.get("itemId") == item_id for item in items)

    # Update item quantity
    item_data["quantity"] = 5
    resp = requests.patch(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{customer_id}/items"), json=item_data, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 202, f"Expected 202, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    # Verify updated quantity
    resp = requests.get(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{customer_id}/items/{item_id}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    assert resp.json().get("quantity") == 5

    # Delete item
    resp = requests.delete(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{customer_id}/items/{item_id}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 202, f"Expected 202, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    # Verify item deleted
    resp = requests.get(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{customer_id}/items/{item_id}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 404, f"Expected 404, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    # Delete cart
    resp = requests.delete(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{customer_id}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 202, f"Expected 202, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    # Verify cart deleted by checking items
    resp = requests.get(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{customer_id}/items"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    assert len(resp.json()) == 0

def test_end_to_end_order_workflow():
    username = f"user_{generate_random_string()}"

    # 1. Register User
    user_data = {
        "username": username,
        "password": "password123",
        "email": f"{username}@example.com",
        "firstName": "Test",
        "lastName": "User"
    }
    requests.post(get_url("user", "/register"), json=user_data, timeout=10)

    # 2. Add Address
    address_data = {
        "city": "London",
        "country": "UK",
        "number": "10",
        "postcode": "SW1A 1AA",
        "street": "Downing Street",
        "userID": username
    }
    resp = requests.post(get_url("user", "/addresses"), json=address_data, timeout=10)
    address_id = resp.json().get("id")

    # 3. Add Card
    card_data = {
        "longNum": "1234567890123456",
        "expires": "12/25",
        "ccv": "123",
        "userID": username
    }
    resp = requests.post(get_url("user", "/cards"), json=card_data, timeout=10)
    card_id = resp.json().get("id")

    # 4. Add Item to Cart
    cat_resp = requests.get(get_url("catalogue", "/catalogue"), timeout=10)
    assert cat_resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {cat_resp.status_code}: {cat_resp.text}"
    socks = cat_resp.json()
    assert len(socks) > 0, "Catalogue is empty"
    item_id = socks[0].get("id")
    unit_price = socks[0].get("price")

    item_data = {
        "itemId": item_id,
        "quantity": 1,
        "unitPrice": unit_price
    }
    resp = requests.post(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{username}/items"), json=item_data, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 201, f"Expected 201, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    # 5. Place Order
    order_req = {
        "customer": f"/customers/{username}",
        "address": f"/addresses/{address_id}",
        "card": f"/cards/{card_id}",
        "items": f"/carts/{username}/items"
    }
    resp = requests.post(get_url("orders", "/orders"), json=order_req, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 201, f"Expected 201, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    order = resp.json()
    order_id = order.get("id")
    assert order_id is not None
    assert order.get("customer", {}).get("username") == username

    # 6. Verify Order Details
    resp = requests.get(get_url("orders", f"/orders/{order_id}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    assert resp.json().get("id") == order_id

    # 7. Verify Payment Authorization
    resp = requests.get(get_url("payment-http", f"/payments/{order_id}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    auths = resp.json()
    assert isinstance(auths, list)
    assert len(auths) > 0
    assert auths[0].get("orderId") == order_id

    # 8. Verify Shipment
    resp = requests.get(get_url("shipping-http", f"/shipping/{order_id}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    assert resp.json().get("orderId") == order_id

def test_user_register_and_login():

    password = "password123"

        "username": username,
        "password": password,
        "email": f"{username}@example.com",
        "firstName": "Test",
        "lastName": "User"
    }

    # Register user
    resp = requests.post(get_url("user", "/register"), json=user_data, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    # Verify registration by logging in
    resp = requests.get(get_url("user", "/login"), auth=(username, password), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    # Negative: Register same user again -> 409
    resp = requests.post(get_url("user", "/register"), json=user_data, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 409, f"Expected 409, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    # Negative: Login with wrong password -> 401
    resp = requests.get(get_url("user", "/login"), auth=(username, "wrongpass"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 401, f"Expected 401, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

def test_payment_authorization_repetition():
    order_id = f"order_{generate_random_string()}"

    payment_req = {
        "address": {
            "city": "London",
            "country": "UK",
            "number": "10",
            "postcode": "SW1A 1AA",
            "street": "Downing Street"
        },
        "amount": 50.0,
        "card": {
            "ccv": "123",
            "expires": "12/25",
            "longNum": "1234567890123456"
        },
        "customer": {
            "firstName": "Test",
            "lastName": "User"
        },
        "orderId": order_id
    }

    # Authorize payment
    resp = requests.post(get_url("payment-http", "/payments"), json=payment_req, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    assert resp.json().get("authorised") is True

    # Authorize payment again for the same orderId
    resp = requests.post(get_url("payment-http", "/payments"), json=payment_req, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    # Verify both authorizations are recorded
    resp = requests.get(get_url("payment-http", f"/payments/{order_id}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    auths = resp.json()
    assert len(auths) == 2, f"Expected 2 authorizations, got {len(auths)}"
    assert auths[0].get("orderId") == order_id
    assert auths[1].get("orderId") == order_id

def test_payment_authorization_boundary():
    order_id = f"order_{generate_random_string()}"

    payment_req = {
        "address": {
            "city": "London",
            "country": "UK",
            "number": "10",
            "postcode": "SW1A 1AA",
            "street": "Downing Street"
        },
        "amount": 150.0, # Amount > 100 should be declined
        "card": {
            "ccv": "123",
            "expires": "12/25",
            "longNum": "1234567890123456"
        },
        "customer": {
            "firstName": "Test",
            "lastName": "User"
        },
        "orderId": order_id
    }

    # Authorize payment with amount > 100
    resp = requests.post(get_url("payment-http", "/payments"), json=payment_req, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    assert resp.json().get("authorised") is False, "Payment should be declined for amount > 100"

    # Verify authorization is recorded as declined
    resp = requests.get(get_url("payment-http", f"/payments/{order_id}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    auths = resp.json()
    assert len(auths) == 1
    assert auths[0].get("authorised") is False
